notices.staleCache: games.bin is stale: OPL shows an old ID for this file
notices.nameIdMismatch: The file name and SYSTEM.CNF disagree on the ID; OPL uses the name
notices.uppercaseExtension: Uppercase extension: OPL shows no ISO/ZSO label
notices.nonAsciiName: Non-ASCII characters in the name may not display or open on the console
notices.smbNameTooLong: File name too long for OPL over SMB (159 bytes)
notices.containerMismatch: The extension does not match the file contents
notices.zsoUnsupportedByProfile: This loader does not read ZSO
notices.cdTooLarge: More data than a PS2 CD holds; probably a DVD
notices.ulPartSize: A ul chunk is not exactly 1 GiB
notices.ulTooManyPartsForSmb: More than 10 ul chunks: OPL cannot open it over SMB
notices.cfgLibconfig: CFG in wOPL's libconfig format; YAOPLM leaves it alone
notices.cfgUnreadable: The CFG file cannot be read
notices.compatibilityBits: Compatibility bits this loader does not know
notices.vmcMissing: The CFG names a VMC that does not exist
notices.vmcInvalid: The VMC file is not a valid memory card image
notices.artNotLoaded: Art file OPL will not load
notices.duplicateStartup: Another game has the same ID; they share CFG, art and cheats
notices.unfinishedOperation: An earlier operation did not finish; recover it first
notices.unsupportedExtension: OPL does not read this file type
notices.noStartup: OPL hides this image: no usable game ID
notices.idNotInName: The ID cannot lead the file name; OPL reads it from the image
notices.titleShortened: The title was shortened to fit OPL's limits
notices.nameTaken: A file with this name already exists on the device
notices.ulTitle: ul.cfg holds at most 32 ASCII characters; the title is shortened
notices.alreadyOnDevice: This game is already on the device
notices.storedAsUl: FAT32 holds files up to 4 GiB: the game is split into 1 GiB ul chunks
notices.titleFromDatabase: The file name has no title; it comes from the bundled database
notices.noSpace: Not enough free space on the device
notices.sourcesDeleted: Source files are deleted after each game is copied
notices.formatNotYetSupported: This file type is not supported yet
notices.badName: The name cannot be used on the device
notices.cannotSplit: The image cannot be split into ul chunks
notices.restartOpl: Restart OPL to see the new name: it notices ul.cfg changes by size only
notices.relatedKept: CFG, art and cheats stay: another game uses the same ID
notices.archiveKept: Art and cheats inside art.tar or cht.tar are not touched
notices.alreadyCommitted: Already visible to OPL, so it is completed instead of undone
notices.journalUnreadable: A journal cannot be read; check the device by hand
notices.systemVolume: This volume holds the operating system
notices.fsUnreadable: OPL cannot read this file system from USB or SD; use exFAT (OPL 1.2.0 beta) or FAT32
notices.exfatNeedsOpl12: OPL 1.1.0 cannot read exFAT; use FAT32 or OPL 1.2.0 beta
notices.fatNeededToBoot: Booting OPL from this device needs FAT32
notices.largeGamesAsUl: FAT32: games over 4 GiB are split into 1 GiB ul chunks
notices.exfatRecommended: exFAT is recommended for OPL 1.2.0 beta: big games stay one file
notices.remoteShare: A network share: OPL's SMB limits apply
notices.clusterSmall: Small clusters slow OPL down; 32 KiB is recommended
notices.gptUnsupported: OPL does not read GPT disks
notices.misaligned: The partition is not aligned to 1 MiB (slower writes)
notices.notExternal: Not a USB or SD device
notices.appleDouble: macOS ._ files slow OPL's scan down
